title: Scalable synthesis of spherical graphite/ZnO composite anodes for high-performance lithium-ion batteries
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,2754-2766
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09552B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Thien Tri Vu, Duy Van Lai, Kien Trung Pham, Phong Quang Le, Thanh Huu Le, Hung Tran Nguyen, Trung-Dung Dang, Duong Duc La
A scalable one-pot hydrothermal method integrates porous ZnO nanosheets onto spherical graphite, creating SG/ZnO hybrid anodes with improved conductivity, stability, and lithium storage for high-performance lithium-ion batteries.
